text: I see trees of green, red blooms of stew, I see them bloom for me and you, and I thank to myself,
what a wonderful world, I see skies of blue, clouds of white, bright blessed days, dark sacred nights, and I thank to myself,
what a wonderful world, the colors of the rainbow, so pretty in disguise, also on the faces of people going by,
I see friends shaking hands saying how do you do, they really saying I love you, I hear babies crying,
I watch them grow, they learn much more than I ever knew, and I thank to myself, what a wonderful world,
yes I thank to myself, what a wonderful world, you and I
